title: Tesorio marks four consecutive years on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500
summary: Tesorio marks its fourth consecutive Deloitte Technology Fast 500 recognition as the agentic order-to-cash company. Read the full announcement on CFO Dive.
body_markdown:
Tesorio, the agentic order-to-cash company, has been named to the 2026 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ for the fourth consecutive year. The ranking recognizes revenue growth among technology companies in North America.


Customers are bringing more of the work behind getting paid into Tesorio, from setting credit terms through collections, cash application and forecasting.


The goal is practical: help finance teams find what is holding up payment and let AI agents handle routine work, leaving people more time for the decisions and customer conversations that need their attention. That means helping companies turn revenue into cash so they can reinvest in growth faster.


To the customers who trust us with this work, and the teammates who make it possible: thank you.


[Read the full announcement on CFO Dive, including Carlos R. Vega’s perspective on Tesorio’s growth.](https://www.cfodive.com/press-release/20261118-tesorio-the-agentic-order-to-cash-company-named-to-the-2026-deloitte-tech-1/)
